spans.s: (I)--a व्रत of a year's duration im- posed on दिती by कश्यप for the birth of a son capable of [page२-344+ २८] killing Indra; details of the व्रत are given; generally begun by a woman with the permission of her husband on the bright fortnight of मार्गशीर्ष; worship of लक्ष्मीनारायण with the हविस् शेष; १२ Ahu1tis made to Agni; this is to con- tinue for twelve months; on the last day of कार्तिकै she should keep fast; next day the husband offers twelve oblations according to the rule of पाकयज्ञ; Brahmanas to be fed and the remnant of the चरु to be offered to his wife; by this one is said to attain desired objects; it can be observed by an unmarried girl or married woman or mother for the sake of auspiciousness. भा. VI. १८. ४७-54; १९. 5-२८.
(II)--here वायु met अञ्जना who gave birth to हनुमान्. Br.
--a class of women who came from the mouth of Asura Bala when he yawned भा. V. २४. १६.
